Where the greatest threat to your own existence are your own crew members. Hungry? Come to the station canteen where the food is definitely poisoned. Injured? Head on down to medical where half a medication has been relabeled as happy pills. Discouraged?

cues.zh: 换成这个。但这不是止痛药，是 LSD。糟糕的迷幻体验？别担心。附近有个保安能帮忙。但他没法回应，因为他被杀了，然后被一只穿着他制服的转基因猴子替换了。

cues.en: Hallucinating?

cues.en: Keep calm and focus on what's real. Unfortunately for you, the super massive black hole expanding towards you is not a hallucination.
cues.zh: 保持冷静，专注于现实。不幸的是，朝你膨胀过来的超大质量黑洞并不是幻觉。

cues.en: It is in fact very real. The emergency shuttle has been called. Welcome to Space Station 13. Space Station 13 has a very simple premise. Everyone has a job. Your objective? Do your best to delay the station's inevitable destruction.
cues.zh: 事实上，它非常真实。紧急穿梭机已经呼叫了。欢迎来到 Space Station 13。Space Station 13 的设定非常简单。每个人都有自己的工作。你的目标？尽最大努力拖延空间站不可避免的毁灭。

cues.en: Either at the hands of antagonists or at the hands of your own incompetent crew. Normally, I give a final score for a game at the end of the video. Not this time. Space station 13, 10 out of 10, amazing, spectacular,
cues.zh: 要么死于敌对角色之手，要么死于你自己那帮无能的船员之手。通常，我会在视频结尾给游戏打个最终分。这次不了。Space Station 13，10 分满分，惊艳，壮观，

cues.en: don't play it. If I'm being perfectly honest with you, Space Station 13 is a fantastic game, but I genuinely don't recommend you play it. Why? Because the engine it's running on is probably older than you. Because the interface is a convoluted mess and only usable because me and every other autistic chimpanzee who plays this game has committed the hotkeys to muscle memory. Because of the insane time investment and commitment required for you to learn a single role and because, to be perfectly honest, the servers can't handle all of you. At best, we could handle like 30 extra players before you grind the servers to a halt. For all these reasons, space station 13
cues.zh: 别玩它。说实话，Space Station 13 是一款很棒的游戏，但我真的不建议你玩。为什么？因为它运行的引擎可能比你还老。因为界面就是一团乱麻，能用只是因为我和其他每个玩这游戏的自闭症黑猩猩都把快捷键练进了肌肉记忆。因为要学会一个角色，需要投入的时间多到离谱，还得有极强的坚持；还因为，说实话，服务器承受不了你们所有人。最好的情况下，我们大概也只能多容纳 30 个玩家，再多就会把服务器拖到停摆。基于所有这些原因，Space Station 13

cues.en: always was and always will be a niche title. And maybe that's for the best. But I can offer you something else. I've already killed your hopes and dreams of playing the game. So instead, let me share some stories of my wonderful experience with space station 13.
cues.zh: 它过去是、将来也永远会是小众游戏。也许这样最好。但我能给你点别的。我已经掐灭了你玩这游戏的希望和梦想。所以，不如让我分享一些我在 Space Station 13 里的精彩经历。

cues.en: These stories span several years and several different servers. The names of which will forever stay anonymous because I respect their privacy. And because I've received threats from some of the more colorful servers to not mention them by name or else. What's gonna happen if I don't comply? Are they gonna hire a bitcoin assassin to run me over with his mobility scooter? Is he gonna stab me with his insulin pen? I don't know. But between you and me, I hate having cum delivered to my mailbox and would prefer to keep it that way. Anyway, I remember the first time playing space station very vividly. My friends told me to download it and hop on some shitty server. It had furries and erotic role play. More on that later. I entered the round as an assistant. My job to give assistance and to get my hands burnt off trying to hack into places I don't have access to. As I'm screwing around with airlock wires, my friend comes running down the hallway dragging someone's unconscious body. Frantically, he tells me, Seth, quick. Can you open this door? Sensing the urgency in his voice, I do. He throws the body inside and sprints away. The airlock closes. Three seconds later, something explodes. What the fuck was that? I ask. Oh, yeah. I fed him potassium and water pills. It takes a while to metabolize.
cues.zh: 这些故事横跨好几年，也涉及好几个不同的服务器。它们的名字会永远匿名，因为我尊重它们的隐私。也因为一些比较“有个性”的服务器威胁过我，不要点名，否则……如果我不照做会怎样？他们会雇个比特币杀手用电动代步车撞死我吗？他会用胰岛素笔捅我吗？我不知道。但私下说，我讨厌有人往我邮箱里寄精液，我更希望保持现状。总之，我清楚地记得第一次玩 Space Station 13 的情景。朋友让我下载它，然后随便进个破服务器。里面有兽迷和色情角色扮演。这个之后细说。我以助手身份进入这一局。我的工作是提供协助，以及在试图黑进没有权限进入的地方时把手烧掉。我正摆弄气闸门线路时，朋友拖着某个昏迷的人沿走廊跑来。他慌慌张张地对我说：Seth，快。你能打开这扇门吗？我感觉到他语气里的急迫，就照做了。他把那人扔进去，然后飞奔离开。气闸门关闭。三秒后，有东西爆炸了。我问：那他妈是什么？哦对。我给他喂了钾片和水丸。代谢需要一会儿。

cues.en: My friend had just murdered a man in cold blood by turning his body into a living, ticking potassium bomb. As soon as the man's digestive juices cracked through the potassium tablet, it reacted violently with the water in his stomach and exploded killing him from inside out. After such a horrific display of homicide, I realized, hey, this game's pretty good. Fast forward a few weeks and I'm learning rolls, calling shots and ignoring every single rule of a server. I also ignored every single rule of medicine. I was a surgeon top of my class, destined to go where no licensed professional ever has. Also, my friend's girlfriend started playing with us. To put it bluntly, she wasn't very good. But she was very interested in progressing the medical field in any way possible. Cargo had just delivered us some complimentary pizza as thanks for patching up their boys after they got a little too intimate with the xenomorphs on mining station. Brilliance flashed before my eyes. My pupils widened. I started physically sweating because she said the words I've always dreamt of hearing. Please turn me into a pizza. And so, I got to work. Nurse, get me my scalpel, tweezers, protractor,
cues.zh: 我朋友刚刚冷血地杀了一个人，把对方的身体变成了一颗活生生、滴答作响的钾炸弹。那人的消化液一蚀穿钾片，钾片就和他胃里的水剧烈反应并爆炸，从里到外把他炸死。在如此骇人的凶杀展示之后，我意识到，嘿，这游戏还挺不错。快进几周，我在学翻滚、发号施令，并无视服务器的每一条规则。我也无视了医学的每一条规则。我是班里顶尖的外科医生，注定要去持证专业人士从未涉足的地方。还有，我朋友的女朋友开始跟我们一起玩。说白了，她玩得不太好。但她非常热衷于以任何可能的方式推动医学领域发展。Cargo 刚给我们送来一些免费披萨，感谢我们给他们的伙计处理伤口——那些人在采矿站和异形有点过于亲密了。灵光在我眼前一闪。我的瞳孔放大了。我真的开始冒汗，因为她说出了我一直梦想听到的话。请把我变成披萨。于是，我开工了。护士，把我的手术刀、镊子、量角器拿来，

I opened the pizza box and began attaching her new cheesy limbs. Help. Sect to surgery. The clown blurted out. He's turning her into a Papa John's. The head of medical stormed in with a host of security officers to detain me, but they were too late. Her hands and feet had already been replaced. Surprisingly,

cues.zh: 于是他用一台巨型战斗机甲直接钻穿了它们。里面的空气很沉重，弥漫着湿毛球和弓形虫病那种甜腻得令人作呕的气味。

cues.en: The furries didn't even have time to react before he started unloading shell after shell of flashbang grenades. And thus, we all got banned. We paid the price. But to see half a server get flash banged unconscious for ten minutes straight, priceless.
cues.zh: 兽迷们还没反应过来，他就开始一发接一发地倾泻闪光弹。于是我们全被封了。我们付出了代价。但看到半个服务器的人被闪光弹闪晕整整十分钟，值了。

cues.en: The server didn't last long anyway. The admin's mom shut it down as soon as she saw the electricity bill. So me and my friends went on to enrich other servers. I even got good at being a chemist. In other words, I always stole the syringe gun at the start of a round and filled it with lethal doses of chloral hydrate for my own protection of course. I also gave whatever chemical anyone requested, which gives me some moral ambiguity and two degrees of separation from any pranks or murders that took place as a result of said chemicals. If a clown asks for space lube, he's gonna get space lube. One time, a clown managed to lube the entire hallway outside of medical, medical, all the way to departures. Now, departures is usually the place where the escape shuttle docks to get us out of our quickly burning heap of a station. However, if there's no call for a shuttle, departures is completely empty. Besides the airlock, which the clown had hacked open. Several people came running through medical, slipped on the space loop, and accelerated
cues.zh: 那个服务器本来也没撑多久。管理员他妈一看到电费单就把它关了。所以我和朋友们转去丰富其他服务器。我甚至练成了熟练化学家。换句话说，我总在回合开始时偷走注射枪，装满致死剂量的水合氯醛——当然是为了自保。谁要什么化学品我就给什么，这让我在道德上有点模糊，也让我跟由此引发的恶作剧或谋杀隔了两层关系。小丑要太空润滑剂，那就给他太空润滑剂。有一次，一个小丑把医疗区外面整条走廊都涂满了润滑剂，从医疗区一路到出发区。出发区通常是逃生穿梭机停靠、把我们从这个快烧成废墟的空间站里接走的地方。不过，如果没人呼叫穿梭机，出发区就完全空着——除了那个小丑黑开的气闸。好几个人跑过医疗区，踩到太空润滑剂滑倒，然后加速冲了出去。

cues.en: themselves face first into the infinite vacuum of space. Security figured out it was the clown. And in true security fashion, also slipped on the space loop. With most of the crew floating around dead in space, the station had to be evacuated. He was later banned from playing clown ever again. Several rounds later, I finally spawned as a traitor. Mission specifications

cues.zh: 一个助理走了进来，浑身流血。因为他大概是想不戴绝缘手套闯进军械库。他的角色贴图肤色拉满，还顶着爆炸头。他的 RP 友好名是 Madick。

cues.en: An idiot, but a useful idiot. There were no medical staff on hand except me. So I said, hey, I know a little bit of surgery. Let me fix you up. I put them under general anesthetic and took out my syndicate PDA.
cues.zh: 一个白痴，但也是个有用的白痴。除了我，现场没有医务人员。于是我说，嘿，我懂一点外科，让我给你处理一下。我给他上了全身麻醉，然后掏出了我的辛迪加 PDA。

cues.en: With this, I can discreetly teleport a few traitor items into my inventory to help me achieve my objective,
cues.zh: 有了它，我可以悄悄把几件叛徒物品传送到我的物品栏里，帮助我完成目标，

cues.en: which in this case was murdering the head of security. I ordered two sets of voice activated explosives which trigger upon hearing the recorded code phrase. I set this to the word most likely to be spoken by this mentally retarded human being. Can you guess what that is? I surgically opened his ass and inserted the first of the explosives. Then I lodged the second one neatly inside his chest cavity. Closing them up, I took off the anesthetic and began to put my plan in action. I would arm this simple minded moron with illegal weaponry with the hopes that security would detain him on possession charges. I gave him all the LSD, all the chloral hydrate syringes, and an entire spray bottle of space lube. I had expertly equipped him to be the ultimate griefing machine. Proud of my work, I gave him a hug and set him loose on the world. But just before he left medical, he turned around and said, thanks, nigger.
cues.zh: 而这次的目标，是谋杀安保主管。我订购了两套声控炸弹，它们在听到录制好的口令时就会引爆。我把触发词设成了这个弱智人类最可能说出的词。你能猜到是什么吗？我用外科手术切开他的屁股，塞进了第一枚炸弹。然后我把第二枚稳稳地塞进他的胸腔里。缝合好后，我撤掉麻醉，开始执行计划。我打算给这个头脑简单的蠢货配上非法武器，指望安保会以持有违禁品的罪名拘留他。我把所有 LSD、所有水合氯醛注射器，以及一整喷雾瓶的太空润滑油都给了他。我以专业水准把他装备成了一台终极搞破坏机器。我为自己的杰作感到自豪，给了他一个拥抱，然后把他放出去祸害世界。但就在他离开医疗部之前，他转过身说：谢谢，黑鬼。

cues.en: And we both exploded. My overtimes playing antagonist went about just as well. Once I started as the leader of a cult, our objective was to seize control of the station and sacrifice our mortal bodies to summon a physical manifestation

cues.en: with our own blood. You see, cultists need to learn a set of ancient words that's randomly generated every round. If you arrange them in the right order, you can perform different spells and rituals to advance your goals. We didn't get far. Because the most dangerous thing to an incompetent cult is a single crew member doing their job. The fucking janitor found us. We tried to negotiate, convince him that it's actually crayon and not blood all over the floor. But that didn't work. So we try to murder him instead. That didn't work either. He used his mop to slip us with soapy water and ran off to call security. As you can see, I'm not very proficient at being a traitor. More often, I find myself being abused by traitors. Some of the worst offenders in this regard are definitely wizards. Since wizards have a bad tendency to sexually abuse me as well. Not too long ago, me and my friends played around that was already in progress. As soon as we entered, we realized something was very wrong. An announcement played on the radio. Penis inspection day is in effect. All crew members must report to Doc Johnson for their mandatory penis inspection. Doc Johnson was very clearly a wizard. I knew what was coming and yet I resigned myself to fate and went to medical reception. Doc Johnson was overjoyed to have new patients. He led me to a private room, asked me if I'm circumcised and told me that I passed the inspection with flying colors. What a surprise I thought. He's not actually gonna grief me. But I was wrong. As I turned away to leave, he blew off my ass magically. Hey, it's wizardry. I ain't gotta explain shit. Anyway, doc Johnson is a terrible doctor. He left me bleeding on the floor as he took my ass cheeks and used them as a hat. Highly unprofessional. Would not recommend. A round of space station 13 can be very intense. At other times, it can be very slow paced and almost relaxing. If you're not a traitor and you don't have anything urgent to handle, you can always just role play and get comfy in a bar. While the piano plays anime songs and the jukebox plays whatever deep fried ASMR bullshit people keep putting on. It's a very wholesome experience and it helps you get emotionally
cues.zh: 用我们自己的血。你看，邪教徒需要学会一组每回合随机生成的古老词语。如果你按正确顺序排列它们，就能施放不同的法术和仪式来推进目标。我们没走多远。因为对一个不称职的邪教来说，最危险的就是一个认真干活的船员。那个该死的清洁工发现了我们。我们试着谈判，说服他地上其实都是蜡笔不是血。但没用。于是我们转而想杀了他。也没用。他用拖把蘸肥皂水把我们滑倒，然后跑去叫安保。如你所见，我不太擅长当叛徒。更多时候，我是被叛徒虐待的那个。这方面最恶劣的惯犯绝对是巫师。因为巫师也很喜欢对我进行性虐待。不久前，我和朋友们玩了一局已经进行中的游戏。一进去我们就意识到非常不对劲。电台播了一则通知。阴茎检查日已生效。所有船员都必须到 Doc Johnson 那里接受强制阴茎检查。Doc Johnson 很明显是个巫师。我知道要发生什么，但还是认命去了医疗接待处。Doc Johnson 因为有新病人而欣喜若狂。他把我带进一间私密房间，问我有没有割包皮，然后告诉我我以优异成绩通过了检查。我心想，真意外。他其实不会恶意整我吧。但我错了。我转身要走时，他用魔法炸掉了我的屁股。嘿，这是巫术。我他妈不用解释。总之，Doc Johnson 是个糟糕的医生。他让我流血躺在地上，还拿我的屁股瓣当帽子。极不专业。不推荐。一局 Space Station 13 可以非常紧张。其他时候，它也可以节奏很慢，几乎让人放松。如果你不是叛徒，也没什么紧急事务要处理，你随时可以只是角色扮演，在酒吧里舒服待着。钢琴弹着动漫歌曲，点唱机放着人们一直在放的那种鬼知道什么的油炸 ASMR 烂活。这是非常温馨的体验，能帮你在情感上

cues.en: invested with the other members of your crew, which are often nice people. However, security is often staffed by egotistical megalomaniacs
cues.zh: 和你船员中的其他成员一起共事，他们通常都是好人。不过，安保部门往往由自大的狂妄分子组成

cues.en: acting out their most depraved power fantasies. They are often not nice people. As a result of their inherent propensity to be insane sociopaths,
cues.zh: 上演他们最堕落的权力幻想。他们通常都不是好人。由于他们天生就有成为疯狂反社会分子的倾向，

cues.en: the rest of the crew will often rebel against their tyranny. In one such case, cargo had declared independence. Security refused to recognize the independent station state of Cargonia. So they tried to barge their way in and arrest everyone involved, including me. But security was unprepared for the trap we had in store. One officer in the cargo bay and slipped on a banana peel straight into the conveyor belt waiting for him. He tried repeatedly to get back up, only to be tripped again by an ocean of banana peels on the conveyor belt which looped around in a circle. Surrounding that circle was another circle composed entirely of vending machines. The officer was also being brutally assaulted by several 100 cans of soda. The vending machines were hacked and as a result, they would continuously fire drinks at whoever is in the area. Each officer that slipped into the banana belt got smashed unconscious by a relentless stream of discount Dan soda. Trademark, all rights reserved. After extensive head trauma by our soda turrets, security reluctantly accepted Cargonia's
cues.zh: 船员中的其他人常常会反抗他们的暴政。有一次，货运部宣布独立。安保部拒绝承认独立的 Cargonia 空间站国。于是他们试图强行闯入，逮捕所有涉事人员，包括我。但安保部没料到我们设下的陷阱。一名警官走进货舱，踩到一块香蕉皮，直接滑进了等着他的传送带。他一次次试图爬起来，却又被传送带上如海的香蕉皮反复绊倒，而传送带绕成了一个圈。围着这个圈的，是另一个完全由自动售货机组成的圈。那名警官还遭到好几百罐汽水的狠狠砸击。自动售货机被黑了，因此会不断向区域内的人发射饮料。每个滑进香蕉传送带的警官，都被源源不断的 Discount Dan 汽水砸到昏迷。商标，保留所有权利。在遭到我们的汽水炮塔对头部的反复重创后，安保部不情愿地接受了 Cargonia 的独立。

cues.en: independence and their right to bear arms. If there's one department that has more revolutions than cargo, it would have to be science. And it's easy to understand why. We spend our lives researching away for the good of a station, which does of course carry its own share of risks and hazards. Sometimes accidents happen. Sooner or later, some bored and mentally challenged assistant will try and put a bag of holding into another bag of holding. And security can't always comprehend that we're not directly responsible for the resulting black hole eating through the kitchen. This lack of appreciation for the scientific profession usually ends with arrest warrants for the whole department. Which is usually answered back with the words, I'd like to see you try. But when we're not having nuclear arms race with security, R and D is actually quite a chill department. I also made a great discovery last time I played there. Me and another scientist were messing around with blueprints and eventually made ourselves a pneumatic cannon. Normally, these are used to launch whatever items you have inside. What we didn't know was that it could launch food as well. I loaded a lasagna, aimed for the mouth, and fired it at my fellow researcher. The lasagna disappeared. What the hell? That's amazing, he said. We just realized what happened. I had just managed to remotely force feed my fellow man. But what do we do with this forbidden knowledge? Nothing good. That's for sure. My comrade got to work asking chemistry for hallucinogenic
cues.zh: 独立，以及他们持有武器的权利。如果说有哪个部门经历的“革命”比货运部还多，那一定是科学部。原因也很容易理解。我们一辈子都在为空间站搞研究，当然也伴随着各自的风险和危险。有时事故就是会发生。迟早会有某个闲得发慌、脑子不太灵光的助理，试图把一个次元袋塞进另一个次元袋里。而安保部总不能理解，由此产生的黑洞把厨房吞了并不是我们的直接责任。这种对科学职业的不尊重，通常以整个部门收到逮捕令收场。而我们的回应通常是：你倒是试试看啊。不过，当我们没在跟安保部搞核军备竞赛时，R and D 其实是个相当清闲的部门。我上次去那边玩时还搞出了一个重大发现。我和另一名科学家瞎摆弄蓝图，最后给自己造了一门气动炮。通常这东西用来发射你装在里面的任何物品。我们不知道的是，它也能发射食物。我装了一份千层面，瞄准嘴巴，朝我的研究员同僚开了一炮。千层面消失了。搞什么鬼？太神奇了，他说。我们这才意识到发生了什么。我居然成功远程强行投喂了我的同伴。可我们拿这种禁忌知识怎么办呢？干不出什么好事。那是肯定的。我同僚开始行动，去找化学部要致幻……

cues.en: drugs. They said no. So we built our own chemistry dispensers, filled up the beakers with happy juice, and ran straight to the kitchen. We injected all the donuts and hot pockets we could find with as much LSD
cues.zh: 毒品。他们说不行。于是我们造了自己的化学分配器，把烧杯装满快乐水，然后直奔厨房。我们给能找到的所有甜甜圈和 Hot Pockets 注入尽可能多的 LSD

cues.en: and mind breaker toxin as they could hold. Then we loaded them into our food delivery system and started firing off at everyone in the hallways. The food was instantly delivered. The crew was instantly satisfied.
cues.zh: 以及它们能装下的精神破坏毒素。然后我们把它们装进食物配送系统，开始朝走廊里的所有人发射。食物瞬间送达。船员们瞬间满足。

cues.en: Several people including security officers managed to see the two small lines of text indicating that they've just been fed something. They thought it was extremely clever and said they didn't know the pneumatic cannon could do that. Since it was just a bit of harmless fun, we got off scot free. Minutes later, the hallucination
cues.zh: 包括安保人员在内的几个人看到了那两行小字，表明他们刚被喂了东西。他们觉得这招非常聪明，还说不知道气动炮还能这么用。因为只是无伤大雅的玩笑，我们没受任何处罚。几分钟后，幻觉

cues.en: started. Crew members started screaming on the radio. Some were puking, shaking or convulsing on the ground. Medical couldn't keep up with the bodies. They piled on too quick and most of the doctors were too busy fighting off non existent entities to do anything about it. The chemist who originally refused to give us LSD was arrested by security on suspicion of intentional food poisoning. It was complete pandemonium.
cues.zh: 开始了。船员们开始在无线电里尖叫。有人在地上呕吐、发抖或抽搐。医疗队根本应付不过来这么多病号。人倒下得太快了，大多数医生又忙着驱赶不存在的实体，根本顾不上处理。最初拒绝给我们 LSD 的化学家被安保逮捕，怀疑他故意投毒。现场完全是一片混乱。

cues.en: And I think it illustrates perfectly the chaos that is space station 13.
cues.zh: 我觉得这完美展现了 Space Station 13 的那种混乱。

cues.en: That's all I have for you today folks. There is of course more stories to tell, but we'd literally be here for hours. Space Station 13, a marvelous, unique and incredibly shitty game. 10 out of 10, don't play it. Because if you do, they're gonna blame it on me. And I hate having cum in my mailbox. As always, more content to come, so stay tuned. On other news, I started a Subscribestar account. So if you'd like to invest and don't wanna give your money to Patreon,
cues.zh: 各位，今天就到这里了。当然还有更多故事可讲，但真讲起来我们得在这儿待好几个小时。Space Station 13，一款奇妙、独特、烂得离谱的游戏。满分十分，别玩。因为你要是玩了，他们会把锅甩到我头上。而我讨厌有人往我邮箱里塞精液。和往常一样，还有更多内容，敬请期待。另外，我开了个 Subscribestar 账号。所以如果你想赞助，又不想把钱给 Patreon，
